transcript: Shayla, you couldn't look more beautiful today, but somehow you're so much more beautiful on the inside.
Your smile, as everybody knows, can light up a room, but your sincere faith and love are your greatest attraction.
You, in the words of the Apostle Peter, have the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God's sight.
It is with greatest joy that I receive you this day to live as one under God's authority until the day I die.
I'm so confident in my commitment to you. It is the easiest choice I've ever had to make.
I am confident in your heart, in your passion for the Lord, and your love for me.
I know you will lead us on the path God desires for us.
I praise God for giving me you. You are an amazing man, and I am so blessed.
I am so blessed to marry you. Today, as you become my beloved, I promise to seek the Lord first, before anyone and anything.
I promise to be faithful to you and only you. I commit to serving you and investing in you.
I promise to cherish you every day, and I promise to cherish every day of this life with you.
I promise to encourage you. I promise to allow you to lead us.
I promise to work with you to further God's love.
I promise to serve you and to serve His kingdom and pursue His mission.
And finally, I promise to always love you, Ryan, all the days of my life.
I just pray for the most perfect day right now, that today is just everything we've always dreamed of and even so much more.
He said, for this reason, a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.
So they are no longer two, but one.
